fences.rule: If the point is what the loss of a retained memory leaves standing and who witnesses it fall, it is there; if the transfer of memory or grief between bodies is the closeness itself under invented rules of embodiment, it is here.
fences.case: An elder peer gnawing a shed carapace to metabolize the errors and frights the original body was too frail to digest.

fences.rule: If the question is what category of value crosses in a non-monetary deal and whether it must be repaid, it is there; if the exchange is a bond under invented body laws and the question is what it costs or reveals, it is here.
fences.case: Root-tips interlaced into a permanent reciprocal sap circuit, each partner supplying the other in shortage with equal volumes returned over a season.
